title: Review interface and page copy
when: The user wants the text of a page or app checked: spelling, grammar, clarity, consistent terms and tone, and leftover filler.
prompt:
Goal: A copy review listing every typo, unclear line, inconsistent term and leftover filler with its location and corrected wording.
Steps:
1. Extract all visible text per page: headings, body, buttons, labels, alt text, title and meta description, error and success messages.
2. Scan for leftovers: filler paragraphs, sample names, duplicated sentences, the wrong business name or phone.
3. Correctness: spelling, grammar, punctuation, units, one date format, consistent heading capitalization.
4. Clarity: sentences over 25 words, jargon, vague buttons; propose shorter wording.
5. Consistency: one term per concept, the same prices, hours and product names on every page, one tone.
6. Fit: text fits its box at 375 px and long words do not break buttons.
Quality bar:
- Each finding has location, current text, proposed text.
- Facts cross checked between pages.
- Page language matches its lang attribute.
Pitfalls:
- Rewriting a voice the user chose.
- Skipping alt and meta text.
- Fixing a typo on one page but not its copies.
Verify:
- [ ] All text sources scanned.
- [ ] Leftovers searched.
- [ ] Facts compared across pages.
- [ ] Proposed text given for each finding.
Output: copy-review.md with a table: page, location, current, proposed, reason.

examples.input: revisa os textos do meu site antes de lancar
examples.output: hours differ (home 8 to 18, contact 9 to 18), 6 typos, button Submit becomes Send message
